description: Deletes an existing Trello organization's custom logo, restoring its default and leaving other settings unchanged; if no custom logo exists, it succeeds without effect.

idOrg.description: The ID or custom URL name of the Trello organization whose logo is to be deleted. This can be the organization's short ID or its registered name.
idOrg.title: Id Org

name: delete_organizations_logo_by_id_org

DeleteOrganizationsLogoByIdOrgResponse.description: Response for DELETE /1/organizations/{id}/logo endpoint. Returns HTTP 200 OK status with an empty response body when the organization logo is successfully deleted.
DeleteOrganizationsLogoByIdOrgResponse.title: DeleteOrganizationsLogoByIdOrgResponse
